title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Heheh, aren't you the lucky one, Doctor? I don't have any work for the day, so I wouldn't mind keeping you company for a bit.

title: Talk 1
original: The marketplaces of Lungmen, the suburbs of Ursus, the ancient ruins of Victoria... Doctor, these lands hold countless beautiful sights, but very few people ever slow down and take them all in.

title: Talk 2
original: Doctor, do you want to hear a story from my travels? In that case, I think we should get some fine tea cakes before we sit down. Otherwise, even the most captivating story will turn boring.

title: Talk 3
original: I've watched plenty of organizations rise and fall, but so far, Rhodes Island is the most interesting one I've seen. Will the epochs bend to your will, or finally swallow you whole...? I'm dying to find out.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Doctor, I have a few ideas where we can get some good food at our next destination. Interested?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Doctor, you seem to already know a thing or two about fallen angels. Unfortunately, I can't give you any more details than what you've got. Even if I shared everything else with you someday, that would stay my one secret.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doctor, you don't need to worry about maintaining a good relationship with me. Friends, family, and love... I've got nothing against them, but I don't need them either. Heh, not like that's going to stop you from trying, right? Well, I don't really mind, so give it your best shot.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Hey, Doctor, I'm back from... Whoa, were you waiting for me here? You even prepared a whole table of snacks... Hehe, all right. How could I turn you down after a gesture like that? In return, I'll tell you about the fun I had on this last delivery run.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: ...I see now. The spark of joy I felt when I thought of having a friend like you wasn't fake after all. Scrap what I said before, Doctor. Maybe I do need a bit of warmth in my life.

title: Idle
original: Hehe... Sweet dreams, Doctor.

title: Onboard
original: Hey there, Doctor. I'm Mostima. You might've heard from Emperor that I'm not bound by the contract between Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, and can therefore act independently. Having that said, I'll probably be staying here anyway when I'm not busy. Sooo, I'll see you around.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Well then, let's see how Rhodes Island fights.

title: Promotion 1
original: You know, Doctor, relying on me isn't a very wise decision.

title: Promotion 2
original: You really want to see me go all out, Doctor? Just for the record, I have to ask… Do I have to pay for the collateral damage I cause? No, right?

title: Added to Squad
original: OK.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Hmm... Sorry, but why don't we let everyone do their own thing?

title: Depart
original: Ah. I know this place. Let me lead the way.

title: Begin Operation
original: Get in, get out.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Uh-huh?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Heh heh…

title: Deployment 1
original: Nice weather today.

title: Deployment 2
original: Great view from here.

title: In Battle 1
original: Seventy percent-ish should do the trick.

title: In Battle 2
original: It's about time to wrap things up.

title: In Battle 3
original: I have nothing against you guys. It's just the story of our lives.

title: In Battle 4
original: I wonder what we should eat after this?

title: 4-star Result
original: Feels good. Guess I could use a thrill every now and then.

title: 3-star Result
original: Hm? I thought I missed a few, but I guess that's a job well done.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: The results of a battle don't really matter to a Messenger. Just surviving is enough of a victory.

title: Operation Failure
original: Gotta admit, this 'teamwork' isn't really my thing.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Mind if I go wander around?

title: Tap
original: Oh?

title: Trust Tap
original: Let's have a chat, Doctor.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: This day used to be like any other for me. Wouldn't stop long at any one place, wouldn't form any serious friendships, wouldn't have fun like everyone else. I never imagined I'd enjoy the holiday atmosphere here. I gotta admit, it isn't half bad. Happy New Year, Doctor, hope we all enjoy it.

title: Greeting
original: How's your day going, Doctor?

title: Birthday
original: So today's your birthday, Doctor. Happy birthday. Would you take an incredible story from my travels as a present? I guess not... alright, how about we take a trip together? I'll pick the scenery, you choose the time.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: The more dangerous the place, the more enchanting the views get. Once you make it through every layer of danger, to finally stand in the eye of a Catastrophe, you're a part of the scenery yourself. In the end, where will you lead Rhodes Island, Doctor? I'm still dying to see.
